scope: Player-reactive route vegetation and physically walkable shallow terrain relief

implementation.notes: Reuses existing registered atlases. Town streets, authored one-way platforms, bridges/machinery and protected arenas are not reshaped. Contact springs and motes have no individual processing callbacks. New relief is retired when a late wall conflicts or its support is disabled.

tests.name: reactive_foliage_smoke.gd
tests.coverage: 17 soft family/type combinations, both directions, settling, swept dash contact, anchoring, wind continuity, room/teleport cleanup, budgets, translated-room particle coordinates

tests.name: route_relief_physics_smoke.gd
tests.coverage: 12 bidirectional standing/crouching walks, 6 dashes, 3 jumps, 9 gold/XP/material drops, continuous downhill floor contact

tests.name: route_relief_world_smoke.gd
tests.coverage: 39 rooms, 134 contours, 842 slope props, 40 real-controller walks in 20 rooms, headroom/device/landing clearance, re-entry, scaled-room and late-wall/disabled-support fixture

tests.name: route_richness_smoke.gd
tests.coverage: All 39 rooms, all 48 route cutouts, 5684 flat-ground clusters, 3493 hanging details, 6 lowered vaults, footprint and re-entry checks

tests.name: world_grounding_smoke.gd
tests.coverage: 39 rooms, 3161 registered surfaces, 15059 contacts, 112 portals, 95 outer boundaries

tests.name: route_vault_traversal_smoke.gd
tests.coverage: 30 real-controller walking/jumping checks below the 6 lowered vaults

runtime_review.renderer: Godot 4.6.2 D3D12 Forward Mobile / NVIDIA RTX 4050 Laptop GPU
runtime_review.warnings: The sandbox reports Windows certificate-store access and native shader-cache write warnings. Captures succeed; no runtime script errors. This is not a frame-rate benchmark.
